duplicate_audit: compressed CT byte equality only; patient/voxel duplicates remain unresolved

partition.method: SHA-256 ranking of additional IDs; test, then validation

settings.cache_dtype: image float32, training label uint8; no held-out label cache
settings.determinism: seeded; deterministic algorithms warn_only=True; not bitwise CUDA reproducibility
settings.empty_class_rule: both masks empty: Dice=1; exactly one empty: Dice=0

inference.restore: argmax on resampled grid, then nearest to original CT grid

settings.initialization: random; never load Block 64 or NV weights
settings.loss: foreground soft Dice + four-class cross entropy; both weight 1; FP32 reductions
settings.preprocessing: closest RAS, native obliquity; linear CT, nearest labels; normalize [-1,1]
settings.resume: epoch boundaries; model, optimizer, scaler and torch CPU/CUDA RNG; interrupted epoch repeats
settings.sampling: uniform case permutation each epoch; uniform class among present classes then uniform voxel
settings.secondary: reference-positive class Dice, reference-negative predicted mL, renal-envelope Dice
settings.selection: maximum mean over validation cases of mean Dice for labels 1,2,3; earliest epoch breaks ties
